## Strategy (AI Generated by Agentic SDLC Pipeline)

### TL;DR

Ship a default-deny network policy baseline for every workload namespace the platform creates, with an allow list generated from each component's declared service graph, and an audit-only rollout mode before enforcement.

### Technical Approach

#### 1. Baseline policy set

The platform operator installs a default-deny ingress and egress NetworkPolicy plus DNS and API-server allowances into each managed namespace.

#### 2. Generated allow lists

Each component declares its peers in a manifest annotation; a controller renders allow policies from those declarations and reconciles drift.

#### 3. Audit-only mode

A per-namespace mode label switches the baseline to log-only so teams can review would-be denials before enforcement.

#### 4. Dashboard and alerts

Denied-flow counters are exported as metrics and surfaced on the existing platform dashboard, with an alert for sustained denials after enforcement.

### Affected Components

- synth-networking (controller, policy templates)
- synth-security (review of the baseline set)
- synth-dashboard (denial panels)

### High Level Requirements

- HLR-1: Install the default-deny baseline into every managed namespace on creation and upgrade.
- HLR-2: Render allow policies from component peer declarations and reconcile drift within 5 minutes.
- HLR-3: Provide an audit-only mode per namespace, with denials logged but not enforced.
- HLR-4: Export denied-flow metrics and add dashboard panels and one alert rule.
- HLR-5: Document the peer declaration format and the migration from audit-only to enforce.

### Dependencies

- The cluster CNI must support NetworkPolicy logging (verified on the reference CNI).

### Non-Functional Requirements

- No measurable latency regression on the platform's reference workloads.

### Acceptance Criteria (Proposed — requires PM/Engineering validation)

- HLR-1 is demonstrated in the release candidate.
- HLR-2 is demonstrated in the release candidate.
- HLR-3 is demonstrated in the release candidate.
- HLR-4 is demonstrated in the release candidate.
- HLR-5 is demonstrated in the release candidate.

### Effort Estimate

M (one to two sprints for two teams).

### Risks

- Undeclared peers in older components cause denials at enforcement; mitigated by the audit-only phase and a pre-enforcement report.

### Open Questions

- None blocking.
